context: Tatsuya has come to Tokyo with a box of fresh produce and a moment to visit aunt Sachiko at her house.
purpose: country-city extended-family kindness — small gift visit

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おばさん、よう来ました。土産です。
lines.en: Auntie, I've come over. Here's a gift.
lines.style: Country bass warm formal-rural opener, the slow direct delivery, soft real respect threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、達也ちゃん、わざわざ。
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm surprised pleasure, the affectionate -chan audible, soft real delight threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 畑のやつ、ちょっと持ってきた。
lines.en: Stuff from the field — brought a bit.
lines.style: Country gruff modest sharing, the casual delivery of the gift, soft real generosity threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こんなにたくさん、悪いわねえ。
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm appreciation with gentle protest, the routine modest receiving, soft real gratitude throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: いえいえ、今年はようけ採れたんで。
lines.en: No, no, this year we got plenty.
lines.style: Country warm dismissing protest, the rural confidence about abundance, soft real generosity threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: みんな喜ぶわ。本当にありがとう。
lines.en: Everyone will be glad. Truly, thank you.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm deep gratitude, the family-warmth carried through the delivery, soft real love threading throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おばさんも元気そうで、安心しました。
lines.en: You look well too, auntie. I'm relieved.
lines.style: Country gruff warm observation, the real concern under the brief delivery, soft sincere care threading throughout.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: なんとかね。達也ちゃんも、無理しないで。
lines.en: Somehow. You too, Tatsuya-chan, don't push too hard.
lines.style: Soft grandmother warm reciprocal care, the family-elder concern audible, soft real love threading throughout delivery.
